scope: Platform/HQ portal: every nav view + action, live (browser via e2e-locked.sh + API)
views_swept: authz matrix (parent/company/freelancer/staff/franchise/no-auth vs 12 GET + 11 write platform routes: all 403/401)

Page engagement listed 'Dashboard' twice (view keys dash + dashboard) and 'Learninghub'
fixed.fix: rows with the same label merged; label 'Learning hub'

fixed.what: HQ Tasks fired /api/listings and /api/bookings (tenant-only) -> 403 console errors
PUT /subscription/pricing accepted a catalogue missing (or repeating) freelancer/company/franchise
Leads stage enum allowed 'interested' which the Sales board has no tab for (lead invisible)
HQ inbox: a thread with status in_progress showed 'Reopen' (couldn't be resolved) and was excluded from Open/Bug counts (inbox 7 vs support review 9)
PATCH /api/leads/:id on a missing id minted a phantom lead (inPipeline -> nameless Sales card)
Prospective leads header said 'whole database' for the capped newest-5000 list (db is ~50k)
fixed.fix: label says list is capped when server reports truncated

fixed.what: Support review 'Manage categories' could be opened before categories loaded -> empty list, Save would wipe every category; inbox thread list overflowed at 375px
fixed.fix: button disabled until loaded; grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] on mobile

fixed.what: Demo slots: duplicate weekday+time templates (3x Mon 10:00 in live data) made the PUBLIC /api/demo-slots list the same slot 3 times (17 vs 14 unique); blackout accepted 2026-13-45; PATCH of a stale template id minted a half-empty template
fixed.fix: public feed dedupes by iso; POST rejects duplicate (409); real-date check; PATCH 404

fixed.what: HQ providers list did one Firebase Auth lookup per tenant (~138) for owner email
fixed.fix: read from users collection, Auth only as fallback (identical output, verified 138/138 rows)

fixed.what: Impersonation audit: only the 'open' click was logged; every change HQ made while acting as an account went unrecorded
fixed.fix: non-GET requests under x-act-as now append to impersonationLog (verified)

open: MRR disagreement: Providers & billing 'Monthly recurring' = GBP 3,037 (falls back to catalogue price for tenants with no snapshotted price) vs Analytics MRR GBP 813 (only snapshotted prices). Product decision which is right.
Lead email is unvalidated (API + UI): 'not-an-email' saved; later demo-booked/answer emails silently no-op. Not fixed because PUT of an old lead re-sends its stored email and would start failing.
Existing duplicate demo-slot templates remain in live data (feed now dedupes, but Templates list shows dupes) - left for Kaz to tidy.
HQ bell poll (60s/tab) reads all tenants + all support threads + demo leads + tasks each time; a TTL cache doesn't help a single tab. Needs narrower queries or a slower poll (Firestore cost).
Providers & billing still shows 'Loading providers...' ~4s+ under load (full tenants/users/libraries reads).
Email and Data & privacy nav items are 'Planned' placeholders (deletion requests only surface in the bell/support).
Impersonation lets HQ perform writes as the tenant (by design) - now logged, but no read-only mode.
International Expansion is a static report with a frozen snapshot (50,489 leads / 0% contacted) that disagrees with the live Sales dashboard.
venture-lakes renders all 1,256 rows at once (~130k chars DOM).
notes: API dev server (tsx watch) restarts on any server edit; three sweep failures (connection refused) were caused by that and re-verified. A different agent's mid-edit TimeClockApp compile error stalled one run for 25 min (holding the e2e lock) - I added per-step timeouts afterwards. All throwaway data (leads, tasks, support threads, demo slot template, features toggle, at-risk contacted flag) removed/restored.
